## Heterogeneity of honest trajectory-max scores by context

ICC = between-context share of variance of the honest trajectory max (raw / normal scores); step_share_ctx = context share of per-step score variance (nested ANOVA); fpr_min/max = realized per-context FPR (%) under one global threshold at 1% / 5% (in-sample); tau = SD of logit per-context FPR at the global 5% / 10% threshold, net of binomial noise (logit-normal random effects; p = LR test of tau = 0); spend_tv = total-variation distance between audit-spend shares and traffic shares at 5%; eb_n0 = empirical-Bayes prior strength (large = homogeneous).
